subject: Post-call: HarborBank security handshake & DPA evidence plan
messages:
From: dylan_brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@harborbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: HarborBank security handshake & DPA evidence plan

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap of what we heard and the proposed next steps so your compliance team can triage: 

Pain points / priorities (what you highlighted)
- SOC 2 scope: you need assurance around logical access, encryption at rest/in transit, and audit log completeness for a 2-year retention window.
- Audit logs & retention: HarborBank requires per-customer audit trail retention options and exportable immutable logs for periodic reviews.
- DPA & subprocessors: specific DPA clauses (data deletion timelines, subprocessors list) need redlines.
- Pen test: HarborBank will require a scheduled pen test window and an outline of responsible-disclosure handling.

What we can provide (short form)
- SOC 2 snapshot (enclosed) and list of available artifacts for in-depth review. [Attachment: soc2-snapshot.pdf (application/pdf)]
- DPA draft with our standard security appendix attached for mark-up. [Attachment: dpa-draft-HarborBank.docx]
- Proposed pen-test windows and intake process (attached). [Attachment: pen-test-schedule-proposal.xlsx]

Immediate next steps (mutual action plan)
1) Your team: confirm preferred pen-test window range (2–3 week options) and identify any additional audit fields you expect in the logs.
2) Our security team (Ben): will share the SOC 2 artifact index and a suggested retention configuration and export format by EOD tomorrow.
3) Legal/compliance: we’ll accept redlines on the DPA; Karthik will coordinate the contract path and a DocuSign placeholder.
4) Quick follow-up: propose a 30-minute compliance sync on Monday 8/9 at 10:00 PT to align owners.

Ben, Marissa — looping you in to own the artifact handoff and runbook.

Laura — if you want a written matrix that maps HarborBank requirements to the exact artifact names we have, we’ll produce that on the sync.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[d] +1 (415) 555-0176

[Attachment stubs]
- soc2-snapshot.pdf (application/pdf)
- dpa-draft-HarborBank.docx
- pen-test-schedule-proposal.xlsx

From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@harborbank.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HarborBank Compliance <security@harborbank.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 17:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: HarborBank security handshake & DPA evidence plan

Dylan — thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifying items from our side after reviewing the attachments quickly: 

- Pen test: we prefer windows that avoid月end reporting cycles; can you provide suggested 2-week windows in September and October? Also need your pen-test rules of engagement (Do you support one-time credentials or supply ephemeral access?).
- Audit logs: important for us — we need the logs in a parseable JSON line format, and retention to be configurable (12/24/36 months). Can you confirm export APIs or S3-bucket delivery?
- SOC 2: the snapshot looks helpful — will your team share a redacted control narrative and the auditor name? Our legal will ask.
- DPA: we’ll pass the draft to legal for initial redlines; could you confirm if Redwood supports customer-requested data deletion timelines under 30 days?

We’ll route this to our procurement and infosec owners; I’ve attached our standard vendor questionnaire for completion.

Thanks —
Laura
Director, Vendor Risk | HarborBank
[Attachment: HarborBank-Vendor-Questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@harborbank.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: HarborBank security handshake & DPA evidence plan

Laura —

Appreciate the follow-ups. A few concrete answers from the security side (short bullets):

- Pen test ROE and windows: we can support both ephemeral access and one-time credentials. Proposed windows (approx): 09/07–09/20, 09/21–10/04, 10/12–10/25. If one of those fits your reporting cadence we’ll reserve it and issue an ROE doc.
- Audit logs & export: logs are available in newline-delimited JSON with event-level timestamps. We can ship via a customer-owned S3 bucket with server-side encryption or provide a signed, time-limited export.
- Retention: default is 24 months; configuration available for 12/24/36 via your contract.
- SOC 2 artifacts: we can provide a redacted control narrative and auditor name (Acuity Auditors LLP). I’m attaching the artifact index and a short readme on what’s available for vendor review. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcSOC2
- Data deletion timelines: we can support customer-requested deletion within 30 days for customer-local datasets; we’ll need the DPA redline to capture specifics for shared logs.

Next steps from security: I’ll drop the artifact index and an exemplar log export schema by 12:00 PT today. Let me know which pen-test window you prefer and I’ll mark our schedule.

—Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: security-artifact-index.csv (text/csv)]
